page.overview:
Who is Geet?

Geet remained loyal to Pavi in a world where the Avatar was viewed as humanity's destroyer. Pavi rode Geet through the wilderness and into the gates of Ellora, and again when they strode through a courtyard. Geet carried Pavi up a wall where they raced alongside Nisha and her cat monkey, Ruhi.

At one point, Geet accompanied Pavi as they watched a massive storm brew on Ellora's horizon.

Geet exhibits exceptional agility, and is able to carry a child on its back while running at high speeds and climbing up walls. Geet also has great dexterity, as evident with its opposable thumbs being able to cling well onto surfaces.
